verdict.rationale: Gumloop's core product is in-product AI agents: you give an agent a goal and tools, it plans the tool calls itself, and you chat with it inside the product, where it produces artifacts and can update its own instructions on request. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegation works well in practice, and evidence of a single default built-in assistant rather than user-configured agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: You give an agent a goal and a set of tools, and it figures out how to get there: which tools to call, in what order, and when to ask you for input.
anything your agent creates can be viewed, downloaded, shared, and version-tracked directly from the chat.
tell it: "Update your instructions so you always do it this way" or "Turn this into a skill."
Gumloop is an AI agent platform. Build AI agents that use your tools and data to do real work
